cases.text: The training code is released in the linked repository. The preprocessing pipeline is provided as prepare_data.py.
The training dataset is ExampleCorpus v2. Evaluation results report an accuracy of 91 percent.
The final model weights are published as model.safetensors. The training configuration lists optimizer and learning-rate settings.
We trained and evaluated the model before deployment.
A research paper and technical report describe the system. Example model outputs are included in the appendix.
